findings.evidenceJa: 当然治療などしていない。
findings.governingReading: Shinji has of course received no treatment for the shoulder Lancer stabbed; the next lines describe its present condition without diagnosing healing progress.
findings.explanation: An untreated shoulder wound becomes a wound that has not healed.

findings.highlight: His laugh turns into a coughing fit.
findings.governingReading: Shinji laughs in a cough-like manner as his injured arm hangs uselessly.
findings.explanation: Laughter resembling a coughing fit becomes laughter turning into an actual coughing fit.

findings.highlight: I want to throw up just thinking about how that cockroach got me!
findings.evidenceJa: あんな死に損ないにとられるなんて、思い出しただけで吐き気がする！
findings.governingReading: Following the statement that Rin escaped, Shinji complains about having her taken from him by someone who was nearly dead.
findings.explanation: Shinji's complaint that Lancer took Rin from him becomes a complaint that Lancer “got” him. This obscures the possessive grievance, although it need not refer only to his injury.

findings.highlight: Why are you trying to act all cool for?
findings.evidenceJa: なに落ち着きはらってんだよ
findings.governingReading: He demands to know why Gilgamesh is remaining so calm.

findings.highlight: another Master that can serve as a Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 依り代になるマスターなら、ここにもう一人いるじゃないか
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh says another Master who can become the anchoring host is right here, identifying Shinji as the body to connect with the child's heart.
findings.explanation: A Master serving as the Grail's host becomes a Master serving as the Holy Grail itself.

findings.highlight: he casually thrusts his arm out.
findings.evidenceJa: 無造作に、その腕を突き立てていた。
findings.governingReading: Without ceremony, he drives his arm into the selected host; the next page delays Shinji's recognition of the impact.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh thrusting his arm into Shinji becomes thrusting it outward.

findings.highlight: as if its performing some outlandish spiritual surgery.
findings.evidenceJa: デタラメな霊媒手術のように
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh's arm merges into Shinji's abdomen like an absurd spiritual-medium operation, without pain or blood.
findings.explanation: The spiritual-surgery comparison contains a visible apostrophe error.

findings.highlight: unable to withstand the discomfort of something wriggling inside him and the pain
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みより、自身の中にびっしりと蠢き回る“何か”の不快感に耐えられず
findings.governingReading: His reason collapses because he cannot bear the packed, writhing presence inside him; this disgust exceeds even the pain of endless growth and death.
findings.explanation: The discomfort of swarming matter overwhelming Shinji more than the pain becomes two equal causes.
